data.title: 黑馆晴奈 · 私密床榻的彻底沦陷温存
data.description: 总统套房主卧奢华松软的丝绸大床上，黑金丝绸睡袍带子已完全解开，雪白紧致的肌肤与动人曲线一览无余。晴奈侧卧在微乱的床褥中，银白长发散落在羽绒枕间。她双眸满溢着无以复加的痴迷与温顺依赖，彻底交托出全部的骄傲与身心。
data.location: luxury penthouse master suite king bed
data.action: 她双眸满溢着无以复加的痴迷与温顺依赖，彻底交托出全部的骄傲与身心
data.lighting: romantic dim golden bedside lamps casting soft seductive silhouettes
data.promptProse: Reclining sideways across the rumpled silk sheets of a luxury penthouse king bed at night, Haruna wears her gold-corded black silk robe completely untied and parted open across her bare shoulders and collarbone. With her long hair fanned out over the plush feather pillows, she looks up toward the viewer with a melted, flushed expression of quiet devotion under warm golden bedside lamplight.
data.animaCaption: Reclining sideways on the penthouse silk bed with her untied black-and-gold silk robe draped open across her bare shoulders and cleavage, Haruna gazes up with flushed, breathless devotion. Warm golden bedside lamplight softens the pillows and shadows.
data.nsfwProse: Her gold-corded black silk kimono robe is untied and loosely draped open across her bare shoulders, collarbone, cleavage, and bare legs on the silk sheets.
